entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkout
entities.reasoning: The checkout deployment was observed to change its replica count from 1 to 0 during the incident window, effectively removing the checkout service.
entities.evidence: Spec change analysis shows spec.replicas changed 1→0 at 2025-12-15T17:54:50Z; related alerts include KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch and KubePodNotReady for checkout pods.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/checkout
entities.reasoning: Service had no ready endpoints because its backing deployment scaled to zero, causing downstream errors.
entities.evidence: NoRequestsDetected and RequestErrorRate alerts for many services reference missing checkout; service endpoints missing in topology.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend observed a warning RequestErrorRate alert while calling checkout, which was unavailable.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert for service frontend (warning) firing throughout the window.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Proxy forwards traffic to checkout; its RequestErrorRate rose when checkout vanished.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert for frontend-proxy (warning) firing continuously.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/recommendation
entities.reasoning: Recommendation service depends on checkout for inventory checks; error rate increased after checkout stopped.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert for recommendation (warning) active; NoRequestsDetected for recommendation.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/fraud-detection
entities.reasoning: Fraud-detection also calls checkout; its RequestErrorRate alert fired.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/quote
entities.reasoning: Quote service received no traffic because checkout downstream was down, triggering NoRequestsDetected.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/accounting
entities.reasoning: Accounting had no requests due to checkout outage, leading to NoRequestsDetected.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/shipping
entities.reasoning: Shipping service lost traffic after checkout stopped, raising NoRequestsDetected.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/payment
entities.reasoning: Payment service showed NoRequestsDetected due to upstream checkout failure.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/currency
entities.reasoning: Currency service experienced no inbound calls after checkout outage.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/email
entities.reasoning: Email service received no requests because checkout was unavailable.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/checkout
entities.reasoning: The service object itself had no pods, reflected by PendingPodsDetected alerts.
entities.evidence: PendingPodsDetected alert (critical) firing for namespace otel-demo.

entities.name: otel-demo/Pod/checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq
entities.reasoning: Checkout pod was not ready and eventually terminated after scaling to zero.
entities.evidence: KubePodNotReady and KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch alerts referencing checkout pods.

alerts_explained.explanation: Error rate above zero for the listed service, caused by downstream checkout being unavailable.
Service received no traffic because upstream checkout had zero endpoints.
Pods were pending scheduling or creation, observed for checkout after scaling to zero.
Deployment replica count (desired vs actual) differed for checkout deployment.
Checkout pod never reached Ready state before being terminated.
Info-level inhibition alert; not directly related to incident.
